summary: Large gravel car park off Brisbane Corso with many cars, no homes nearby.
reasons: Big gravel lot, well off the lane
Many cars parked; van blends in
No dwellings, only parkland and utilities

drivers.seclusion: Parkland, trees and a sewage works behind; nearest buildings are non-residential, 40 m or more away.
drivers.access_and_room: Open gravel entry from the Corso at both ends; room for many vehicles clear of traffic.
drivers.traffic: Busy arterial beside the lot, but the van stands clear of the lane.
drivers.convention: Seven or more cars parked in a row, plus a caravan-style trailer on the grass.

flags: Low-lying: about 6 m elevation, river about 100 m north
Traffic noise from Brisbane Corso and the junction
Mapped parking is open access, no fee
sun_shade: Open gravel in full sun; trees shade the south edge and a large tree the east end.
cannot_judge: Time-limit or no-camping signs on site

best_section.where: Gravel parking area south of Brisbane Corso, west end away from the junction
